opennyai_summary.decision:
By way of the present application, the petitioner/applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No.426/2023 registered under Sections 376 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act at P.S. Tigri, New Delhi.
Let the same be placed on record before the next date of hearing, which shall also indicate the previous involvements of the applicant, if any.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
Let the notice be also served to the complainant/prosecutrix/her guardian through the concerned Investigating Officer.
In case she requires a legal aid counsel, the I.O. shall assist the complainant/prosecutrix/her guardian in approaching the Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee to appoint a counsel in accordance with rules to represent the complainant/prosecutrix in the present case.
The panel counsel so appointed shall get in touch with the complainant/prosecutrix through the concerned I.O.
In the meantime, let the nominal roll of the applicant be also requisitioned through the Registry.
